title: Shapley value axiomatic characterization
summary: Formalizes finite TU cooperative games, the Shapley value formula, and the four axioms of efficiency, symmetry, the null-player property, and additivity. It proves that the Shapley value satisfies all four and proves uniqueness via unanimity games and Möbius inversion over the Boolean lattice. This is a reusable formalization artifact, not a claim of new mathematics.

review.reason: Formal Lean development of the Shapley value axiomatic characterization.
